stages.name: discovery
stages.description: Collect normalized public leads from allowlisted sources.

stages.name: verification
stages.description: Confirm exact immutable revisions and primary Apple/ExecuTorch evidence.

stages.name: ranking
stages.description: Rank leads with transparent popularity and mobile-signal inputs.

stages.name: implementation
stages.description: Use the model registry and adapter strategies to wire platform POCs.

stages.name: validation
stages.description: Validate the snapshot contract and repository gates.

stages.name: delivery
stages.description: Commit and push only validated changes; preserve the no-change path.

limitations: Popularity and community signals are discovery aids, not proof of iOS or Android execution.
Exact immutable revisions and primary Apple Core AI/ExecuTorch evidence must be reviewed before changing the verified inventory.
Unavailable sources remain visible as errors; a run is invalid only when every source fails.
